messages:
jamie: deploy-bot flagged a values checksum mismatch on payments-service during the EUW release window. can someone take?

deploy-bot: preflight failure: values-merge-checksum != expected. canary halted and marked for rollback unless manual pin applied. link: https://ci.redwood/integrations/1234 :warning:

sara: ack — I see an overlay change to replicaCount and a late env var from luis' PR. small change but changed the values hash. diff: https://git.redwood/ops/infra/compare/refs/heads/last..pr-4987 :eyes:

luis: apologies, that was supposed to be staged only. I pushed a scaling tweak (replicaCount: 4 -> 6) to the eu overlay by mistake. can we pin chart to previous published version instead of full rollback? pin is less disruptive for payments.

jamie: agree pinning is preferable. plan: pin payments-service to chart v2.8.1, re-trigger canary on eu-west, monitor 10m. if health spikes or latency regresses, we rollback. oncall-sre - can you standby? :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: oncall standing by. also add a note to release notes about the emergency pin.

sara: to pin run deploy-bot pin-chart payments-service --chart-version=2.8.1 --reason="post-merge eu overlay drift". I'll run it now and push a quick release-note blurb.

luis: thanks. running pin now. output: ```deploy-bot: pinned payments-service chart=2.8.1 by sara; triggered canary-retry```.

deploy-bot: canary retry started (run id 31123). health target: 99.5%% P99 latency <= 120ms. will post back on completion.

jamie: Sara — after canary completes, update release notes and notify product. Keep the changelog entry minimal: "pinned chart to 2.8.1 to mitigate unintended overlay change; scaling tweak deferred to next release."

sara: done — release notes updated and PMs pinged in #product. final check: if canary fails, we follow rollback playbook (team call + hotfix).

deploy-bot: canary success. metrics ok, no error rate increase. marking canary promoted. :tada:

jamie: nice. leave a postmortem note on the PR to remind people to target staging overlays. closing this thread. :rocket:
